title: Chapter 33
text: About the Author Jane Lenore (J.L.) Vampa is an author of Dark Fantasy and Victorian Gothic fiction. She also owns a macabre-style bookish shop, Wicked Whimsy Boutique, and teaches writing courses via the Vampa Writing Academy. She lives in Texas with her musician husband and their two littles who are just as peculiar as they are. Instagram TikTok Goodreads
